goal: Qualify frozen production persistence v2 at 10k, 50k, 100k, and 250k under explicit resource safety gates without changing production semantics.
acceptance_criteria: run production v2 sequentially at 10k, 50k, 100k, and 250k only after resource gates pass
separate normal update, checkpoint, compaction, cold-start, workload, and crash-safety costs
preserve the frozen persistence, checkpoint, compaction, migration, Knowledge, retrieval, and Conversation semantics
adopt v2 for new packs only after every scale and correctness gate passes

quality_metrics.measure: all available filesystems below 75 percent use before formal execution
production implementation and benchmark harness hashes remain unchanged

assurance: RAM, process RSS, and pagefile captured
control: 10k not started while every volume failed the hard gate
no user-owned data, repository, evidence, or authoritative pack deleted
improvement: resume only after a benchmark volume is below 75 percent use with peak headroom

interface_expectations: ProjectKnowledgePack remains the sole logical authority
production v2 source stays frozen at 3439370f3e0a5ba118199dce10d429e77b77e24f
benchmark results remain NOT_EVALUATED rather than inferred
existing v1 packs remain readable and never auto-migrate

feedback: No fixed local volume satisfied the less-than-75-percent used hard gate.
Memory fell from 78.57 percent to 68.05 percent, so disk capacity is the decisive blocker.
No disposable production-v2 scale workspace existed; 125.85 MiB of generic caches was materially insufficient to open the gate.
No formal scale worker was started and no production or harness source was changed.

worked: fail-closed preflight prevented unsafe disk pressure
separating resource bounds from product failure
preserving the frozen source and prior correctness evidence
did_not_work: the host had no volume below the required 75 percent utilization threshold
safe scratch discovery found no material disposable v2 benchmark corpus
experiments: resource preflight only; 10k formal measurement intentionally not started
